text:
deploy-bot: Canary deploy for telemetry-service (rev: 2f9a7b) finished in prod-us-east-1. Noted metric rename in telemetry PR #482.

maya: heads up — after the canary landed p95/p99 overlay disappeared from the latency dashboard (Console → Metrics → Service latency). p50 still shows. Anyone seeing the same? :eyes: 

sam: yep saw it on my screen. p50 and avg present, the 95/99 lines are just gone. Dash link: https://console.redwood.ai/d/latency/service-latency

aleks: digging in — can you confirm whether this is a grafana rendering bug or prometheus returning no series? I'll run a couple queries.

aleks: quick checks against Prometheus: 
```
# query for old metric (no results)
count({__name__=~"request_duration_seconds.*"})
> 0
# but when I query the new prefix we have series
count({__name__=~"telemetry_request_duration_seconds.*"})
> 24
```

aleks: looks like the telemetry instrumentation in PR #482 added a prefix `telemetry_` to the metrics. Grafana panels still reference `request_duration_seconds` so histogram_quantile() returns empty for those panels. :thinking_face: 

maya: odd that p50 still shows — I checked the panel config: some panels use a different metric `request_latency_ms` (legacy) which wasn't changed, so those still render. The percentile panels rely on the histogram metric.

jon: short term options: update the dashboard queries to the new metric name OR add a recording rule / exporter alias to keep old names. Which do we want for prod?

aleks: short-term patch: update critical dashboards so SLOs don't show blanks. Long-term: telemetry team should either add compatibility recording rules or coordinate rename with a dashboard migration plan.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1296 (dashboard-metrics-dependency). Assigned to telemetry-team.

maya: I'm going to change the service-latency dashboard query in prod to reference the new metric and verify. Patch incoming.

maya: patch applied. New query (example):
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(telemetry_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, service))
```

maya: Verified in Grafana — p95 and p99 lines reappeared for the service panel. I've left the old panels untouched for now except the critical one.

sam: thanks — can you add a note to the incident with the dashboard ids changed and the PR that renamed metrics? Will help telemetry team rollback/plan.

maya: done. Incident has links to PR #482 and the dashboard edits. Also added a short runbook step: if metrics disappear after deploy, grep metric names with `curl $PROM/api/v1/label/__name__/values | grep <service>` to find new prefixes.

jon: great. Follow-up: telemetry team — please either ship recording rules for compatibility or file a dashboard migration checklist. We've got a couple dozen dashboards still pointing at the old names.

aleks: marking the thread resolved for eng-sre; keep INC-2026-1296 open for telemetry to close after compatibility or migration.

sam: resolved from our side. :thumbsup:
